notes.title: Hyperglide Portals Update!
notes.content:
Hello everybody

We just released a cool update that allows you to go from one Map to the next one seamlessly.
Simply fly through a portal or enter the ocean and your new level will generate.

Also included are some performance improvements!

Have fun gliding!

notes.title: New and improved terrain generation
notes.content:
Hello dear Hypergliders

It's been a while, but we have an important update ready for you with the following improvements:

[list]
[*]Level Generation speed increase of up to 100000% - in other words, it's super fast now.
[*]Performance boost especially with VERY LOW/LOW Quality Settings
[*]Increased level size a bit
[/list]

We hope you'll enjoy this update. Let us know if you experience any issue.

Happy gliding and all the best.

notes.title: Level Generation Speed Update
notes.content:
In this update, we focused on making the level generation faster. Currently it's about 3-4 times faster and there's still room for further optimizations.

All updates:
[list]
[*]Big speed improvements to the level generator
[*]Reworked artifact placement
[*]Collecting all 5 artifacts now gives you a 10000 point bonus
[/list]

Please let us know if you encounter any issues with the level generation.

Happy gliding!

notes.title: Public Beta Release
notes.content:
Hi everybody

You can now join the public beta release, which features the following changes:
[list]
[*]Big speed improvements to the level generator
[*]Reworked artifact placement
[*]Collecting all 5 artifacts now gives you a 10000 point bonus
[/list]

To join the beta, simply right click Hyperglide in your Steam Library, then select Properties and go to the "Betas" tab to select the "beta" channel.

Please let us know if you encounter any issues with the level generation.

Thank you

notes.title: A small update
notes.content:
Hi everybody

A small update hast just been published:

[list]
[*]"Compatibility mode" ON is now the new default
[*]Removed "compatibility mode" toggle in the settings
[*]Fixed a bug that caused each level generation to take longer than the previous one 
[/list]

Let me know if you experience any issue.
Thank you all

notes.title: Maintenance and compatibility update
notes.content:
Hello Hypergliders

There's a new update out with the following changes:
[list]
[*]Reduced game size on disk from 1300mb to 640mb!
[*]Further optimizations and RAM/VRAM usage reduction
[*]Added Compatibility Mode in the Graphics Settings. If you're world doesn't properly generate or if you experience crashes, try setting compatibility on.
[/list]

Please let us know in the comments if you're still experiencing issues with world generation when compatibility is on.

Thanks and have fun gliding!

notes.title: And another important update
notes.content:
This update should fix the issue where:

[list]
[*]Pressing the south button (A on Xbox Controller) while playing could crash the game
[*]The Level keeps regenerating when pressing the A button
[/list]

Big thanks to those that reported this bug.
We wish you all crash free gliding!

notes.title: Some small fixes
notes.content:
Hey everybody

We just uploaded another small update:

[list]
[*]Reduced Seagulls Sound slightly
[*]Added Seagulls SFX Volume Slider
[*]Added Wind SFX Volume Slider
[*]Generator requires less VRAM now
[/list]

If you encounter any new issues, please let us know.

Thanks and have fun gliding!

notes.title: It's alive
notes.content:
Hey Hypergliders

So version 1 is finally out! In case you played the demo, here are some updates that you can expect:

[h2]Done and released in version 1.0[/h2]
[list]
[*]Smooth Levels Geometry
[*]More interesting levels with lots of caves
[*]Level Texturing variations
[*]New Skies
[*]Snow Level
[*]First Person View
[*]Improved player handling
[*]Improved performance
[*]New Main Menu Design
[*]Player Settings are now synced in the cloud
[*]A new Player Model
[*]Ragdoll when crashing
[*]Various Bug fixes
[*]Flappy Wingsuit Wings
[*]Different Vegetation Colorings
[/list]

Thanks for all your support!

notes.title: Hypergliders Playtest Hi-Score Competition
notes.content:
Hey everybody, we're planning a little contest for the Hypergliders Playtest.

Prizes:
The Top 3 of the "High Score" Leaderboard will receive:
1. 25CHF Steam Gift Card
2. 10CHF Steam Gift Card
3. 5CHF Steam Gift Card
The gift cards will be sent directly through Steam to the top 3 Users.

How to Join:
1) Request Playtest Access at https://store.steampowered.com/app/1638520/Hypergliders/
2) Check back in this thread or in our Discord https://discord.gg/Rtq7usp to see when the competition starts and ends. Players in the playtest queue will also receive an email from Steam.

More info:
The contest will launch when we have 200 new Playtesters waiting for access and will run for about a week, so please let some people know. The current leaderboard will be reset when the competition starts.
